notes.title: The MOST SPECIAL update to the DEMO EVER! (Also 1,000 Subscribers on Youtube).
notes.notes:
In celebration of a new demo and 1,000 subscribers on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@cattrigger_games]Youtube[/url], I would like to announce the most special of all special updates to the demo and the upcoming full game of "Date Time".

That's right...

[previewyoutube=I6YtlWKLotE;full][/previewyoutube]

iiiiiit's a GAME CURSOR!

The ultimate addition to "Date Time", a GAME CURSOR reminiscient of the Classic Mac OS.  This has been a long time coming, I have spent a gazillion hours trying to figure out how to do this via code or hacking or telepathy... but then realized all I had to do was drag 'n' drop an image into the 'cursor' box in Unity.  



[b]Oh... also some fixes:[/b]


[b]Version 2.1b:
[/b]


-Reworked text printers to be completely static to prevent text jittering, rapid unintentional skipping or artifacting.  If you're still having problems, please contact me at https://www.cattrigger.com/links.


-Solved bug where players who go to Petya before completing the Melissa Chapter would come upon a black screen when returning to Petya.


-FIxed a graphical error near the end of the Anna Chapter Preview where a graphic that changed, flashes back to its initial state for a brief moment.

notes.title: Date Time Demo v2.1 Changelog - Small Fixes,
notes.notes:
Thanks again for everyone who has played the Date Time Demo, so far.  Here are a few fixes due to player feedback:

[h2]Date Time Demo v2.1[/h2]

[b]1 - Standardized Text to prevent breaking text printers in the game.  [/b]

If you are still experiencing odd text printer errors, such as screens auto-skipping text, text seemingly being cut-off from the screen, or text seeming like excerpts being the only things shown on the screen, please delete your save profiles at:

WINDOWS: 

C:\Users\[Your Name]\AppData\LocalLow\CatTrigger\Date Time Demo

MAC:

~/Library/Application Support/com.CatTrigger.Date-Time-Demo

LINUX:

.config/unity3d/CatTrigger/Date Time Demo

[b]2 - Fixed an error where visiting PETya before completing the Melissa chapter leads to a black screen when re-entering PETya's section.[/b]

Please let me know if there are any other errors you might've bumped into.  Thank you so much!

[i]NOTE:

As reported by some Mac Users via the Non-Steam version of the Demo, please check your app security settings to make sure it allows for unauthorized or non-app store related applications to run.

If you are still unsure how to do it, please use Steam to download the Mac version.  [/i]

notes.title: Upcoming Demo Update - Anna / Melissa Alt-Path
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Thank you for playing Part 1 of the Date Time❤️ demo.[/b][/h1]
Over 5,000 downloads and counting! 

Wow!    [b]Melissa [/b]was SO THRILLED to have another go, a new upgrade to her systems and the ability to play with her new toys. Think of this enhanced version as the expectation going forward for both dates with [b]Morris & Anna.[/b] 




[b] Speaking of Anna...[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bQZ7hew.png[/img]

[b]Let's talk a bit about the upcoming demo update.[/b]



You've dated the bookish [b]Melissa[/b]... and maybe even the shy [b]Morris[/b]. But [b]Anna [/b]is a different person from both.

She's outgoing. She's confident. And she'll do everything possible to [b]get what she wants[/b].

[b]Anna [/b]brings forth a [b]dating adventure[/b] that eclipses both Morris & Melissa in [b]length, intrigue, and challenge.[/b]



[img]https://i.imgur.com/RA4ZaDE.png[/img]

Explore the ever growing idyllic town of Date Time❤. You're not just going to the park to look for swans, or eating a delicious strawberry salad at the cafe. You've got [b]places to go, people to see... and quests to complete[/b] to help build your friendships with the town folk.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cA1aqZW.jpg[/img]



Meet with the local sports enthusiasts at the [b]Recreational Center[/b], talk politics with the Mayor of the town at [b]City Hall[/b], and if your car's broken, get it repaired at [url=https://i.imgur.com/dNif0ML.png][ENTITY NOT FOUND][/url]

But, at the end of the day, you'll be meeting up with Anna at the overlook of the town: [b]MT. SALVATION[/b].

If you play your cards right, she'll give you an [b]eternal smooch[/b], a final end to this beautiful trilogy of ours!

Anna will capture your heart in ways Morris... or even Melissa... CAN'T.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/TFwu8Rr.png[/img]

[u][/u]
[h3]Speaking of Melissa...[/h3]
...we've heard you. You want [b]a different ending.[/b] Maybe an [b]even happier one[/b] with our original ol' shareware gal?

Don't worry. You will. 

A [b][VERY IMPORTANT PERSON][/b] is going to help you with that, don't be nervous. We can do it together.

I have [b]FAITH.[/b]
